context: Teacher and student discuss a documentary on AI and humanoid robots
purpose: Teach: 人工/地下/地上/耐え/苦笑/辞典/ペット/ヒト

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 昨日の人工知能のドキュメンタリー、見ましたか？
lines.en: Did you watch yesterday's documentary on artificial intelligence?
lines.style: Polite teacher opening, gently checking if the student watched the broadcast.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 見ました。地上波であんな深い内容、珍しいですよね。
lines.en: I watched it. It's rare to see such deep content on terrestrial TV.
lines.style: Casual but respectful university student tone, showing genuine interest.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ。特にあの地下の研究施設の場面が印象的でした。
lines.en: Yes. The scenes in the underground research facility were especially striking.
lines.style: Polite reflective teacher voice, sharing a personal impression softly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ヒト型ロボットが人間そっくりで、ちょっと怖かったです。
lines.en: The humanoid robots looked just like people; it was a bit scary.
lines.style: Honest casual reaction from a young adult, slightly unsettled tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ペットの代わりにロボットを飼う家庭も出てきましたね。
lines.en: There were even households keeping robots in place of pets, weren't there.
lines.style: Polite observational teacher tone, inviting student to reflect further.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うちの祖母も寂しさに耐えられなくて、ロボット犬を買ったんですよ。
lines.en: My grandmother couldn't bear the loneliness and bought a robot dog herself.
lines.style: Personal anecdote in soft casual register, slightly wistful confession.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうなんですか。技術の進歩は辞典の定義も変えてしまいそうですね。
lines.en: Really. Technological progress may even rewrite the definitions in dictionaries.
lines.style: Polite philosophical remark from teacher, thoughtful and measured pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 確かに。先生も苦笑してましたけど、未来はもう来てる感じですね。
lines.en: True. You were smiling wryly too, professor, but the future feels here already.
lines.style: Light casual closing remark, friendly teasing toward the teacher warmly.
